zh.title: Wingcopter發表全電動偵察無人機Wingcopter 262
zh.summary: Wingcopter發表全電動無人機，滯空時間可達6小時。
body: 德國無人機製造商Wingcopter發表名為Wingcopter 262的全電動偵察無人機。該無人機採用傾轉旋翼配置，無需發射設備即可進行垂直起降，並能轉換為固定翼飛行。該機型展翼長度為2.62公尺，最大起飛重量為10公斤，其滯空時間最長可達6小時，設計戰術航程為150公里。
Wingcopter 262採用模組化設計，支援配備人工智慧技術的電光與紅外線相機。該機型具備可在全球衛星導航系統（GNSS）訊號受阻時進行導航的定位技術。此外，Wingcopter正與烏克蘭製造商TAF Industries合作，除量產烏克蘭偵察無人機外，亦致力於將Wingcopter 262提供給烏克蘭使用。

en.title: Wingcopter Unveils Wingcopter 262 Electric Reconnaissance Drone
en.summary: Wingcopter unveils the Wingcopter 262 electric reconnaissance drone, capable of remaining airborne for six hours.
body: German unmanned aircraft manufacturer Wingcopter has unveiled the Wingcopter 262, an all-electric reconnaissance drone. Designed for vertical takeoff and landing without launch equipment, the aircraft utilizes a tilt-rotor configuration to transition into fixed-wing flight. The drone features a 2.62-meter wingspan, a maximum takeoff weight of 10 kg, and can remain airborne for up to six hours with a tactical range of 150 kilometers.

The Wingcopter 262 features a modular design that supports electro-optical and infrared cameras with artificial intelligence capabilities. It incorporates positioning technology capable of navigating when global navigation satellite system (GNSS) signals are unavailable. Wingcopter is also cooperating with Ukrainian manufacturer TAF Industries under the "Build with Ukraine" initiative to mass-produce Ukrainian drones and supply the 262.

zh.title: 義大利飛安機構研究指出乘客使用折疊登機梯摔倒風險較高
zh.summary: 義大利飛安機構研究指出，乘客使用折疊登機梯跌落風險顯著偏高。
body: 根據義大利國家航空安全局（agency for flight safety）所提出的一項研究報告結論，旅客在搭乘航班並使用客機內建的折疊登機梯（retractable airstairs）時，面臨顯著較高的摔倒與跌落風險。
航機配備自備登機梯能夠實現更快速的旅客登機與下機流程，特別是在停泊於遠端停機坪時，無須等待機場地面服務設施車輛抵達即可直接進行作業。
雖然折疊登機梯這項設備並非瑞安航空（Ryanair）旗下波音737（Boeing 737）客機所獨享，但該航空集團確實是目前全球營運中使用此項登機梯功能規模最大的航空公司之一。

en.title: Italian Flight Safety Agency Study Highlights Fall Risk on Retractable Airstairs
en.summary: An Italian flight safety agency study finds passengers using retractable airstairs face higher fall risks.
body: A study by Italy's agency for flight safety concluded that passengers who have used retractable airstairs face a significantly higher risk of falling during boarding and offloading operations.

Carrying built-in retractable airstairs allows aircraft to achieve faster passenger boarding and offloading. This capability provides operational advantages particularly at remote airport stands, where aircraft might otherwise need to wait for airport ground services to arrive before passenger handling can begin.

Although retractable airstairs are not unique to Ryanair's fleet of Boeing 737 aircraft, the airline group is recognized as one of the largest operators employing this specific feature across its operational route network.

zh.title: Hermeus獲普惠授權製造F100戰鬥機引擎
zh.summary: Hermeus獲普惠授權組裝F100引擎；推進高超音速無人機開發
body: 美國航太新創公司 Hermeus 與 RTX 旗下的普惠公司（Pratt & Whitney）簽署許可協議，獲得授權組裝與製造 F100-PW-229 戰鬥機噴射引擎。這項協議使 Hermeus 能夠取得在內部組裝 F100 引擎的權利，以支援其高超音速無人飛行器平台的開發計畫。
普惠生產的 F100 系列引擎長期用於 F-15 與 F-16 戰鬥機。Hermeus 則將 F100 引擎作為其 Quarterhorse 無人機系列推進機制的一部分，協助該系列飛行器在測試及未來任務中達到高馬赫數飛行速度。
除了直接組裝 F100 引擎外，Hermeus 正研發名為「Chimera」的推進系統。該系統將預冷型 F100 引擎與衝壓噴射引擎結合。由於衝壓噴射引擎沒有運動部件且專為高超音速設計，必須先獲得初始加速才能產生推力，因此預冷型 F100 引擎負責提供啟動衝壓噴射所需的加速度。
在測試進展方面，Hermeus 此前已測試搭載 GE J85 引擎的 Quarterhorse Mk 1，以及裝配預冷型 F100 引擎的 Quarterhorse Mk 2 與 Mk 2.1。其中，Quarterhorse Mk 2.1 於 2026 年 5 月 26 日在新墨西哥州白沙飛彈靶場的試飛中首度突破音障，達到 1.21 馬赫的速度。
Hermeus 執行長扎克·肖爾（Zach Shore）於 2026 年 9 月 15 日發布聲明表示，成為 F100 引擎的授權製造商，能夠擴大美國國防工業基礎的本土發動機產能。這項合作也使 Hermeus 成為少數具備自主推進系統能力、得以推動 Quarterhorse 計畫規模化的垂直整合航空器製造商。

en.title: Hermeus Obtains License from Pratt & Whitney to Manufacture F100 Jet Engines
en.summary: Hermeus has secured a license from Pratt & Whitney to assemble F100 engines for hypersonic aircraft.
body: Aerospace startup Hermeus has signed a licensing agreement with RTX subsidiary Pratt & Whitney to manufacture F100-PW-229 fighter jet engines. Under the terms of the agreement, Hermeus obtains the right to assemble its own F100 engines to support the development and scaling of its hypersonic unmanned aircraft platforms.

The F100 engine series, produced by Pratt & Whitney, serves as the primary propulsion system for F-15 and F-16 fighter jets. Hermeus incorporates the F100 engine as part of the propulsion mechanism that will enable its Quarterhorse family of unmanned aircraft to reach high Mach speeds during testing and operational flights.

In addition to assembling standalone F100 engines, Hermeus is developing its proprietary "Chimera" propulsion system, which combines a precooled F100 engine with a ramjet. Because a ramjet features no moving parts and requires initial acceleration to generate thrust at high supersonic speeds, the precooled F100 engine provides the speed necessary before the ramjet can take over. The completed Chimera system is expected to power future iterations of the Quarterhorse aircraft.

Hermeus has previously flight-tested several prototypes in the series, including the Quarterhorse Mk 1 powered by a GE J85 jet engine, as well as the Quarterhorse Mk 2 and Mk 2.1 equipped with precooled F100 engines. On May 26, 2026, the Quarterhorse Mk 2.1 broke the sound barrier for the first time, achieving a speed of Mach 1.21 during a test flight over the White Sands Missile Range in New Mexico.

Hermeus Chief Executive Officer Zach Shore stated on September 15, 2026, that becoming a licensed manufacturer of the F100 expands domestic propulsion manufacturing capacity for the broader defense industrial base. Shore noted that the agreement positions Hermeus as one of the few vertically integrated airframers with the in-house propulsion capability required to scale the Quarterhorse program.

zh.title: 阿斯塔納航空將於10月起恢復阿拉木圖與阿斯塔納至杜拜航班
zh.summary: 阿斯塔納航空宣布10月初起恢復阿拉木圖及阿斯塔納至杜拜航線。
body: 哈薩克國家航空阿斯塔納航空（Air Astana）宣布，將自2026年10月初起，恢復從該公司位於哈薩克的兩大樞紐航點前往阿聯杜拜的定期客運航班。這項決定標誌著該航線在經歷數月的停飛後重新啟航。此前由於中東地區局勢持續緊張，該公司曾多次延長該航線的暫停營運時間。
根據阿斯塔納航空公佈的復航規劃，阿拉木圖至杜拜航線將率先於2026年10月1日恢復營運，初期提供每週4班服務，並計畫於10月底前逐步擴增至每週12班。阿斯塔納至杜拜航線則預計於10月2日復航，開航初期為每週3班，並於10月底前提升至每週10班。航空公司採取漸進式增加運能策略，而非立即恢復至全額班次。
阿斯塔納航空表示，公司將持續密切監控中東區域局勢發展，後續航班時刻表仍可能根據當地情勢變化進行調整。若未來有任何最新異動，航空公司將及時向乘客發布相關訊息。

阿斯塔納航空至杜拜的航線在2026年間曾面臨多次中斷與恢復。該公司最早因空域限制而暫停阿聯航線，後於7月4日恢復阿斯塔納直飛杜拜航班，並在8月初擴增為每日1班。然而7月12日區域軍事緊張升溫，導致班機被迫再次停飛，其中由阿斯塔納飛往杜拜的KC205航班在中途折返，阿拉木圖飛往杜拜的KC897航班則於起飛前取消。隨後因霍爾木茲海峽及波斯灣周邊狀況，停飛期先後延長至7月21日、8月31日及9月30日。

en.title: Air Astana to Resume Dubai Flights from Almaty and Astana in October
en.summary: Air Astana will resume scheduled flights to Dubai from Almaty and Astana in early October.
body: Air Astana has announced that it will resume scheduled passenger flights to Dubai from both of its Kazakh hubs starting in early October 2026. The decision brings an end to a suspension that had been in effect since July 2026, which saw multiple extensions throughout the year as regional tensions escalated in the Middle East.

According to the carrier, service from Almaty to Dubai will be the first to restart on October 1, 2026. Flights will initially operate four times per week before gradually increasing to 12 weekly flights by the end of October. Meanwhile, operations on the Astana to Dubai route will resume on October 2, 2026, beginning with three flights weekly and expanding to 10 weekly flights by month's end. Air Astana noted that capacity will be rebuilt incrementally rather than restoring full frequency immediately.

The airline stated that it will continue to closely monitor regional developments across the Middle East. It highlighted that flight schedules remain subject to adjustments depending on how conditions evolve, and passengers will be notified of any further changes to planned operations.

The resumption follows a period of repeated disruptions on the carrier's Gulf routes during 2026. After an initial suspension due to airspace restrictions, Air Astana briefly restored nonstop Astana-Dubai service on July 4, 2026, expanding to daily flights by early August. However, rising military tensions prompted a re-suspension on July 12, 2026, when flight KC205 from Astana to Dubai turned back mid-journey and flight KC897 from Almaty was cancelled before departure. Subsequent extensions pushed the suspension through July 21, August 31, and ultimately September 30, 2026, as the airline cited ongoing instability across the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.

zh.title: NBC新聞直升機洛杉磯墜毀 三人罹難
zh.summary: NBC新聞直升機；洛杉磯查茨沃斯墜毀；三人罹難
body: 美國洛杉磯消防局（LAFD）證實，一架NBC地方新聞直升機於2026年9月15日當地時間18:57在洛杉磯查茨沃斯（Chatsworth）地區墜毀，機上三人死亡。這架直升機當時正在報導一起巴士碰撞事故，該事故造成另外兩人死亡。
消防局長Rico A. Gross在新聞記者會上證實，直升機墜毀造成3人死亡，另有兩人被送往醫院，但兩名傷者狀況尚未經地方當局證實。洛杉磯警局公共資訊官員Brandon Silverman向現場記者表示，其中一名死者是在停車場的「行人」。
這架直升機隸屬於NBC洛杉磯與Telemundo 52，當時正在報導巴士車禍，被當地新聞台稱為NewsChopper4。據NBCLA報導，該直升機由Angel City Air營運，機上死者為Angel City Air工作人員Eliana Moreno和飛行員George Marciniw。
根據Aviation Safety Network的資訊，該直升機為Eurocopter AS 350 B2 ECUREUIL，註冊編號N358TV。在社交媒體上流傳的一段未經證實的影片中，傷亡直升機上的一名女性聲音說：「你拉不起來。」CNN記者埃利克斯·麥可森提到，一名資深洛杉磯直升機記者寫道：「引擎故障。可以聽到低旋翼轉速警報器響起。」
NTSB在其社群媒體上表示：「NTSB正在調查9月15日在加利福尼亞州查茨沃斯的Eurocopter AS 350 B2直升機墜毀事件。」FAA也在其網站上說，已知一架Eurocopter AS350在查茨沃斯於當地時間週二（9月15日）下午約7時墜毀，機上兩人。FAA和美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）將進行調查，NTSB將主導調查。
加州州長紐森表示：「我們的心與今夜查茨沃斯災難性的Metro巴士和直升機墜毀事故的受害者與家人同在，也與整個NBC4家庭同在。」洛杉磯市長Karen Bass說：「我們今天失去了五位洛杉矶人。」

en.title: Three killed as NBC helicopter crashes in LA while covering fatal bus collision
en.summary: NBC news helicopter crash in Chatsworth, LA; three dead, two hospitalized; NTSB and FAA investigating.
body: The Los Angeles Fire Department (LAFD) confirmed that an NBC local news helicopter crashed in the Chatsworth area of Los Angeles at 18:57 local time on September 15, 2026, killing three people on board. The helicopter was covering a bus collision that had already resulted in two other deaths.

Fire Department Chief Rico A. Gross confirmed at an overnight press conference that three people died in the helicopter crash and two others were taken to hospital, though their condition has not been confirmed by local authorities. LAPD Public Information Officer Captain Brandon Silverman said at the scene that one of the deceased was a pedestrian in a parking lot.

The helicopter, identified as NewsChopper4 by the local station, was operated by Angel City Air, according to NBCLA. The victims aboard were identified as Angel City Air staff members Eliana Moreno and pilot George Marciniw. Aviation Safety Network identified the aircraft as a Eurocopter AS 350 B2 Ecureuil, registered N358TV.

Both the NTSB and FAA released statements. The NTSB said it is investigating the Sept. 15 crash, and the FAA stated the crash occurred around 7 p.m. local time with two people on board. The FAA will investigate alongside the NTSB, which will lead the probe.

Unverified footage on social media showed an onboard voice saying 'You can't pull up,' as the aircraft lost altitude. A witness told NBCLA the helicopter came 'oddly, coming straight down,' but these observations have not been validated by the investigation.

The LAFD confirmed that the NTSB and FAA will investigate the incident. The Governor of California and the Mayor of Los Angeles both addressed the casualties and offered support to the victims' families.
